title: Suggested times can be removed from the draft and follow its recipients
steps: Launch with -UseFakeData -UseFakeCalendar, open a conversation, press r, show the calendar (Control-Command-C) and press Suggest times
Press Insert in draft, then Replace, then Remove; press Cmd+Z in the draft
Add a recipient, then press Other times
expected: Insert puts the times in once and the box says In your draft; Replace swaps them in place, Remove takes them out and Cmd+Z puts them back. After a recipient change the times dim with a note and are found again on their own; Other times offers different ones. Another conversation clears the box completely, and going back does not bring it back. Nothing is added to the calendar.
